title: Timing: 32-Bit Priority Encoder
constraints: `idx` = index of the **lowest** set bit of `req`, and `valid = |req`. When `req = 0`, `idx = 0`. Purely combinational.
Timing budget: at most **12 logic levels** (the Synthesis stage reports the depth). A priority chain (`for` loop with `if`) is far deeper.
hints: Divide and conquer: encode each 16-bit half, then pick the lower half if it has any bit set, and prepend one index bit.
Recursively: an n-bit encoder = two n/2-bit encoders + one mux level, so the depth grows as log₂ n.
Write it as a recursive function over the width, or as explicit levels (pairs → quads → …).
